avoid_supplements.name: High-dose iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Iron may increase GI irritation and worsen diarrhea; linaclotide-induced fluid secretion may impair iron absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for worsening diarrhea and anemia

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Linaclotide's osmotic effects may reduce probiotic colonization; theoretical benefit unclear
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; may use if beneficial for GI symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Antidiarrheal supplements (psyllium, calcium polycarbophil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May counteract therapeutic effect of linaclotide
caution_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if needed for symptom breakthrough, space doses and monitor efficacy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and alter local drug effect timing; may exacerbate diarrhea
caution_foods.action: Take linaclotide on empty stomach as directed; counsel on consistent meal timing

caution_foods.name: Foods high in fiber (sudden increase)
caution_foods.mechanism: Combined with linaclotide's secretory effects may increase diarrhea severity
caution_foods.action: Advise gradual fiber increase; monitor for excessive fluid loss and electrolyte imbalance

monitoring_notes: Linaclotide undergoes minimal systemic absorption and hepatic metabolism, resulting in very low drug-drug and drug-supplement interaction potential. Primary monitoring should focus on adequate hydration status, electrolyte balance, and managing osmotic diarrhea symptoms during treatment initiation and dose adjustment.
